title: Dynamic context curation and tool selection
overview: Implement the context routing system where the orchestrator curates task-relevant context for each sub-agent, filtering out distracting information. Build a ToolRegistry that manages available tools and allows the orchestrator to select subsets per subtask.
problem_statement: Sub-agents need only relevant context and tools for their specific subtask, not the full conversation history.
motivation: Context filtering prevents context rot and tool selection enables specialized capabilities per subtask.
success_criteria: ToolRegistry managing available tools with metadata
Orchestrator selects relevant tool subsets per subtask
At least 4 built-in tools: calculator, code_execute, web_search_mock, file_read
technical_constraints: Tools must have consistent interface (name, description, execute)
